description: For customer complaint, this checklist records customer statement, desired resolution, urgency, safety or privacy screen, ownership, response commitment, and remedy limits. Its supporting evidence includes communications, order or service record, photos, logs, staff statements, policy references, and resolution evidence.

subtitle: Customer Complaint Checklist: customer complaint intake, investigation, and recovery using customer account, customer statement, and communications.
title: Customer Complaint Checklist
use_case: Use the checklist during customer complaint intake, investigation, and recovery when the customer complaint record must identify customer account, contact, product or service, transaction, channel, affected location, and prior complaint history. Complete the applicable handoff for approved response, customer confirmation, credit or corrective action, root-cause referral, trend coding, and closure.
